{{Top|leg}}
'''Gintwin''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Gintwin warned readers of the Datalog against firing vintage [[pulse-wave rifle]]s unless they thoroughly checked them first, especially for microfractures around the [[power cell]] housing and for warping and micro-corrosion of the barrel. Gintwin had come across a crate of the weapons, and upon checking them found the weapons had metal fatigue.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
